critique: The faceted vermilion, emerald, cobalt, and yellow shelf-colonies accreting downward across fine ledger rules create a bold high-key taxonomy, while the inset seam of mint ceramic cups introduces a genuinely surprising material analogy. The cup footage remains a highly conventional grid and the 15-pixel guinea pig reads as an arbitrary near-invisible Easter egg; transforming the seam’s rigid repetition or making the animal structurally affect the colonies would better fulfill the promised unfamiliar visual grammar.
